rites.name: Kalunaroma
rites.text: Kalunaroma is the concept of the first sounding in Venualys, the note by which the world's roots gathered into form during the Singing. It is less a being than a pattern of resonance that the early realm kept returning to as it settled.

rites.name: Osyuthizeth
rites.text: Osyuthizeth is the concept of resonance that holds the first roots of Venualys together as they condense out of the Singing. It is less a being than a pattern of tension that the early groves learned to sing back to.

rites.name: Isavsith
rites.text: Isavsith is the concept of binding, the quiet law by which the broken shards of Venualys were held to their oaths during the Sundering. It is less a force than a promise written into the dark between worlds, invoked whenever a Pact must be kept. Its strength grows with every oath that holds.

rites.name: Venellys
rites.text: Venellys is a concept in the Venualys omniverse, a binding force that the orders of the Walled Age used to hold their walls and first crossings together. It is said to have steadied the groves and growing kingdoms of the first sovereign's reign, though no sovereign ever fully controlled it.

rites.name: Anataroma
rites.text: Anataroma is the concept of the thin, threshold-breaking pull that lets a place be left behind, which the Walled Age's orders learned to bind into their gates and vows. During the Age of Sundering it became the force that let landfall tear old bonds apart and let people cross into new lands.
